_comment: Config for LUMYVUE_V6_Training_Pipeline_Open.ipynb (development). Researcher-labelled validation is accepted (EVAL_REQUIRES_DERMATOLOGIST=false). Controlled comparison D vs E; B, C and D2 stay available by adding them to GLOBAL_EXPERIMENTS. Folder names are not used as weak labels (USE_SOURCE_LABEL_AS_WEAK_POSITIVE=false), so D and E train on human-reviewed rows only. One seed for a first, shorter run: restore [42, 7, 123] to assess variability.
